# project-memory

> project-memory is a free, open-source (MIT) plugin for Claude Code. After every reply it saves a journal of the exchange and a note of where you stopped, on your own computer, so the next conversation starts where the last one ended. No account, no API key, no server, no AI model writing the notes.

It makes no network connections of its own; what Claude reads still goes to Anthropic as usual. Secrets are replaced with [redacted] before anything is saved (no tool catches every secret). Old versions of your notes are kept if Git is installed (optional). Needs Claude Code and Node.js 22 or newer. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux. Search is by words, not by meaning. Claude Code only. No sync between computers or teammates.

## Docs
- [Project page](https://zdraveski.github.io/project-memory/): what it does, how it works, install
- [README](https://github.com/zdraveski/project-memory#readme): install, commands, privacy
- [Releases](https://github.com/zdraveski/project-memory/releases)

## Install
/plugin marketplace add zdraveski/project-memory
/plugin install project-memory@project-memory
